name: khilona
description: Khilona shop platform — three independently deployable apps: API, storefront, admin panel.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix khilona_backend install && npm --prefix khilona_userpanel install && npm --prefix khilona_adminpanel install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix khilona_backend run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix khilona_backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix khilona_backend run build && npm --prefix khilona_userpanel run build && npm --prefix khilona_adminpanel run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix khilona_backend run lint && npm --prefix khilona_userpanel run lint && npm --prefix khilona_adminpanel run lint
scripts.test:api: npm --prefix khilona_backend test && npm --prefix khilona_backend run test:e2e
